# TftpdR 0.2.1

Patch release for the read-only TFTP (RFC 1350) server and native
[Slint](https://slint.dev/) desktop panel. Both Windows executables now embed
the product icon as a PE resource, so Explorer, shortcuts and the task bar no
longer show the generic executable icon. Protocol, configuration and runtime
behaviour are unchanged from `0.2.0`.

**中文摘要**：0.2.1 是补丁版本。两个 Windows 可执行文件现在内嵌产品图标
（7 帧，16–256 px），资源管理器、快捷方式和任务栏不再显示通用图标；协议、
配置格式、默认端口与运行时行为均与 0.2.0 一致，无破坏性变更。

## Downloads

| Platform | Archive |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x86_64 (MSVC) | `tftpd-r-0.2.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Windows arm64 (MSVC) | `tftpd-r-0.2.1-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Linux x86_64 (glibc) | `tftpd-r-0.2.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| Linux arm64 (glibc) | `tftpd-r-0.2.1-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |

Every archive contains `tftpd-r` (headless daemon), `tftpd-r-gui` (desktop
panel), `config.example.toml`, `README.md`, `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE`.
Windows archives also include `tftpd-r-gui.ico` for tools that want the icon
file. `SHA256SUMS` covers all assets in this release.

## What's new

### Windows executable icon

- `tftpd-r.exe` and `tftpd-r-gui.exe` now carry `app-icon.ico` as an
  `RT_GROUP_ICON`/`RT_ICON` PE resource with seven frames: 16, 24, 32, 48, 64,
  128 and 256 px. Explorer, shortcuts and the task bar use this file icon.
- A build-time-only crate, `tftpd-r-build-support`, reads the committed ICO and
  writes a `.res` file into `OUT_DIR` during `cargo build`. MSVC links that
  `.res` directly; GNU targets convert it to a COFF `.rsrc` object with
  `windres` from MinGW-w64 binutils.
- No generated `.res`/`.o` file is committed and no runtime dependency was
  added. On non-Windows targets the helper is a no-op.
- The running panel still uses `app-icon-128.rgba` for its window and task-bar
  icon; the PE resource only changes the icon of the executable file itself.
- ADR: [`docs/adr/0011-windows-executable-icon.md`](https://github.com/greyskysoul/tftpd-r/blob/v0.2.1/docs/adr/0011-windows-executable-icon.md).

If Explorer still shows the old generic icon after upgrading, refresh it with
<kbd>F5</kbd>, or restart Explorer / clear the Windows icon cache.

## Compatibility

- No breaking changes. The TOML configuration format, `port` +
  `bind_addresses`, the read-only RRQ protocol and the default
  `127.0.0.1:69` are unchanged from `0.2.0`.
- `0.2.0` configuration files can be reused as-is.
- Windows archives still include `tftpd-r-gui.ico` as a sidecar for shortcuts
  and deployment tools; it is now also embedded in both executables.

## Verification status

The GNU x64 build on Windows 11 with Rust 1.100.0 was verified as follows:

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D
  warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass; the suite is **148 tests**.
- `cargo build --workspace --release --locked` succeeds. The generated `.res`
  is byte-for-byte identical to the output of `windres -O res` for
  `1 ICON "app-icon.ico"` (112,368 bytes).
- A PE resource probe found the `RT_GROUP_ICON` and all seven `RT_ICON` frames
  with matching byte counts in both debug and release executables.
  `ExtractAssociatedIcon` returned the `dns` artwork at 32x32.
- The release GUI `--smoke-test` exits 0 with empty stdout/stderr; a release
  daemon downloaded a 5,000-byte file byte-for-byte and exited 0 after
  Ctrl-Break.
- The icon resource adds 112,640 bytes per executable: `tftpd-r.exe` is
  1,357,824 bytes (1.29 MiB) and `tftpd-r-gui.exe` is 8,846,848 bytes
  (8.44 MiB) in this GNU x64 build.

The release workflow first runs the full test gate on `windows-latest` (MSVC)
and `ubuntu-latest` (GNU), then builds the four native targets. The `v0.2.1`
workflow
([44882456726](https://github.com/greyskysoul/tftpd-r/actions/runs/44882456726))
passed the test gate, built all four archives and published this release.

After publication, the `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` archive was downloaded and
checked: its SHA-256 matches `SHA256SUMS` and GitHub's asset digest; both MSVC
executables contain the seven-frame icon and were inspected with
`FindResourceW`; `tftpd-r --version` reports `0.2.1`; the GUI `--help` and
`--smoke-test` exit 0; and the daemon downloaded a 5,000-byte file byte-for-byte
and exited 0 after Ctrl-Break. MSVC file sizes are 1,193,984 bytes for the
daemon and 8,513,024 bytes for the GUI. The aarch64 archives were not executed
and their icon resources were not inspected.

Nothing below is verified or claimed by this release:

- running the GUI or daemon on a Linux desktop, or any `aarch64` binary
  anywhere;
- interoperability with real or legacy external TFTP clients, LAN/`0.0.0.0`
  operation, firewall rules for TID ports, and binding port 69 as an
  unprivileged user;
- RDP sessions, real keyboard/IME input, screen readers, Explorer's icon cache,
  shortcut icons, and rendering at other DPIs, locales or font stacks.

Linux binaries link the glibc of the CI runner (`ubuntu-latest`); build from
source on older distributions. The GUI needs an X11/Wayland session at runtime;
the daemon does not.

## Checksums

`SHA256SUMS` is attached to this release; verify with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`
or `Get-FileHash` on Windows.
